verdict.rationale: Basecamp publishes a documented public REST API with an OpenAPI spec covering authentication, pagination, and every endpoint. Supporting docs describe OAuth 2.0, cURL examples, total-count headers, conditional 304 caching, Retry-After rate-limit handling and file downloads, and point AI agents to an official CLI and Skills. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
OAuth 2.0 allows users to authorize your application to use Basecamp on their behalf without having to copy/paste API tokens or touch sensitive login information.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
